The property asserts that cells/proofs from `compute_cells_and_kzg_proofs` should pass `verify_cell_kzg_proof_batch` — a cryptographic guarantee of the KZG scheme. Grandine correctly delegates to external `rust-kzg` libraries with consistent backends and trusted setups. This is a specification-level invariant, not an application enforcement requirement. Consensus spec tests validate both functions independently against test vectors.
